components.text: Sign in to the Figshare account you want to connect. A personal token grants full access to that account.
Open your account Applications page and create a personal token. Enter it in the protected field. Figshare documents Authorization: token as the request header.
Test makes a read-only GET /v2/account request and checks the returned account ID. Save encrypts the token after a successful check. You can replace the token later from the Credentials page.
Independent connector for Figshare. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Figshare.
